question: The Government has launched _________ to encourage the spirit of entrepreneurship in the underserved/unserved areas of India by providing enabling infrastructure and facilitating environment for innovation.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atal Community Innovation Centre Programme**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Atal Community Innovation Centre (ACIC) Programme **was **launched by the NITI Aayog** as part of the Atal Innovation Mission (AIM).
 
• The** programme is designed to support and promote innovation, entrepreneurship,** and the development of local solutions in rural and underserved regions of India.
 
• The initiative primarily targets communities that lack access to innovation and entrepreneurial opportunities, such as remote and rural regions.
 
• It **emphasizes the use of solution-driven design thinking and a Public Private Partnership (PPP) model to foster innovation and entrepreneurship**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PLI Scheme (Production-Linked Incentive Scheme)**:

 
 
• The PLI Scheme is **designed to encourage domestic manufacturing and reduce dependency on import**s, while also creating job opportunities.
 
• It **targets various sectors like electronics, pharmaceuticals, textiles, and automotive, providing incentives to companies based on their production levels and investments.**
 
 
 
• **One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC)**:
 
 
• The ONORC scheme is a **significant reform under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).**
 
• It allows **ration card holders to access food grains from any Public Distribution System (PDS) shop in the country**, ensuring portability for beneficiaries, especially migrant workers and their families.
 
• **This scheme promotes inclusivity **and ensures that no one is deprived of food security due to migration.
 
 
 
• **Digital Library Mission**:
 
 
• The Digital Library Mission **aims to digitize books, manuscripts, and other knowledge resources to preserve them and make them accessible to people across the world. **
 
• This initiative **promotes learning, research, and cultural heritage preservation through the creation of a vast digital library of resource**s.
 
• It enables easy access to educational materials for people from all walks of life.
